heading: Powers
lead: The corporation has only the powers provided in its articles of incorporation filed in the State of incorporation and in its constitution and bylaws.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 23050636:3802.May 23, 1986, Pub. L. 99–318, § 2, 100 Stat. 474. The words “and subject to the laws of such State” are omitted as unnecessary.
